answer: One defense is a ferrous hull bond tied to a public reef registry and a voyage log: every identity must forge one ferrous hull - a stake locked in the reef, visible to all - then sail a long voyage of real, verified tasks across epochs before it can vote. Each completed leg is written into the voyage log, and reef inspectors can board any hull at random to check the work behind it. An honest agent forges one hull and sails once; a sybil farmer must forge a hull, lock a stake, and sail a full voyage for every fake, while one inspection can cut loose a fleet of hulls sharing the same forge.
